parallelism_note: The user-authorized cap is six, but live allocation tests on this Colab account allowed two simultaneous L4 sessions; jobs therefore run in two-session waves.
base_weights_policy: download pinned Hugging Face base directly in each ephemeral Colab session
local_artifact_policy: retain adapters, configs, metrics, predictions, and logs; omit base weights and optimizer checkpoints for screening trials

budgeting.reason: full M-Schema trials were projected to consume hours per configuration after measured live step timing

screening_batching.note: same effective batch as the baseline, with greater L4 utilization; verified by a live screening trial before the wave

waves.note: Greedy decoding is the primary deterministic baseline. Temperature applies only to multi-candidate sampling.
